expected.result_summary: Thus, O brahmin, have the good and bad results of the bhavas been told to thee. The result of every one of them is to be declared by discrimination of strength and weakness. When a graha has attained full result, declare the result in full; at a half, a half; when short by a quarter, a quarter here.

If retrograde, or in its own fourth, Mars gives its result; Mercury in the fourth, and Jupiter and the Moon and Venus in the fifth; the eclipse-node for the seventh, and for the fifth and the ninth; and the Moon gives its own result for the second when the Sun is at the equinox.

A movable sign glances the fixed signs and a fixed sign the movable; each leaves aside the sign next to it and glances the remaining three. Aries, leaving Taurus aside, glances Leo, Scorpio and Aquarius; the dual signs glance one another — Gemini glances Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces.

A yoga arises between Saturn and Jupiter …; Jupiter, by dependence on another, is malefic …; Venus is directly the killer, marked with maraka-hood; Saturn and the rest, the malefic grahas, become killers. Thus are the good and evil results to be known for those born in Aries.

Jupiter, Venus and the Moon are malefic; Saturn and the Sun are benefic; Saturn alone is directly the maker of raja-yoga. Jupiter and the rest are the malefics bearing the mark of the maraka; Mercury stands there [neutral].
Mars, Jupiter and the Sun are malefic; Venus alone is benefic. Jupiter's yoga with Saturn is as it was for Aries. The Moon here is not a killer.
Venus and Mercury are malefic; Mars and Jupiter benefic; Mars alone is directly the yoga-karaka. Saturn is the killer; the others are called marakas.
Mercury and [Saturn] are malefic; Mars and Jupiter bring good. The mere conjunction of Jupiter and Venus is not auspicious here. Mercury and the rest are marked with maraka-hood.
Mars, Jupiter and the Moon are malefic; Venus alone is benefic. Venus and Mercury together are the yoga-karakas. Venus is the killer; Mars and the rest are marakas.
Jupiter, the Sun and Mars are malefic; Saturn and Mercury benefic. The Moon and its son [Mercury] become the makers of raja-yoga. Mars kills; Jupiter and the rest bear the mark of the maraka.
Mercury, Mars and Venus are malefic; Jupiter and the Moon benefic; the Sun and the Moon become the yoga-karakas. Jupiter is the killer; Mercury and the rest are called marakas.
Venus alone is malefic; Mercury and the Sun are benefic. The yoga is from the Sun and Mercury. Saturn, the Sun's son, is the killer; Venus and the rest strike, marked with maraka-hood.
Mars, Jupiter and the Sun are malefic; Venus and Mercury benefic. Saturn is itself the killer, and Mars and the rest besides. Venus alone makes the good yoga.
Jupiter, the Moon and Mars are malefic; Venus, the preceptor of the daityas, alone is benefic. Mars, Venus and Jupiter make raja-yoga. Mars and the rest are killers, marked with maraka-hood.
Saturn, Venus and the Sun are malefic; Mars and the Moon are benefic. Mars is the cause in the yoga. Having regard to the marakas and the karakas, Saturn and Mercury, being malefic, strike.

Following this sastra the wise should declare the marakas: apart from the Moon and the Sun, all are proclaimed marakas. In its own dasa and its own bhukti there is no death for men; some allow it in the dasa, but never in one's own bhukti.
The 5th falling in a sign of Venus and Venus joined to it, with Saturn joined to the 11th — lord of much wealth.
The 5th in a naksatra of Mercury with Mercury joined to it, and the Moon and Mars in the 11th — lord of much wealth.
The 5th in a sign of Saturn with Saturn there, or Mercury standing in the 11th — lord of much wealth.
The 5th in the Sun's sign with the Sun joined to it, and Jupiter standing in the 11th — lord of much wealth.
The 5th in a sign of Saturn with Saturn joined to it and Mars joined to the 11th — lord of much wealth.
The 5th in a sign of Jupiter with Jupiter joined to it — lord of great wealth.
The lagna in the Sun's sign with the Sun placed there, joined to or aspected by Mars and Jupiter — wealthy.
The lagna in the Moon's sign with the Moon there, joined by Jupiter and Mars — the native born is wealthy.
The lagna in a sign of Mars with Mars joined to it, joined to or aspected by the Moon, Venus and Saturn — the man becomes rich.
The lagna in a sign of Jupiter with Jupiter joined to it, joined to or aspected by Mercury and Mars — the native is a master of wealth.
The lagna in a sign of Mercury with Mercury joined to it or aspecting, and Saturn and Venus joined or aspecting — the man born is wealthy.
The lagna in a sign of Venus with Venus joined to it, and Saturn and Mercury joined or aspecting — the man born is wealthy.

Whatever grahas are joined to or aspected by the lord of the 9th and the lord of the 5th are givers of happiness; those joined to the lord of the 8th and the lord of the 12th, and to the maraka lords, are givers of sorrow.
The lord of the lagna gone to the 12th and the lord of the 12th come to the lagna, joined to or aspected by a maraka lord — the man born is without wealth.
The lord of the lagna gone to the 6th, or the lord of the 6th come to the lagna, the lagna lord aspected by a maraka lord — the native becomes poor, and conspicuously so.
The lagna joined by the Moon and Ketu, or the lagna lord gone to the 8th, joined to or aspected by a maraka lord — the native becomes poor.
The lagna lord gone to the 6th, 8th or 12th and joined to a malefic, and joined to or aspected by a maraka lord — even one of royal line is without wealth.
The lagna lord joined to the lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th and aspected by malefics, and not aspected by benefics — he becomes destitute.
The lord of the friendly house and the lord of the 9th standing respectively in the 6th and the 10th, and aspected by a maraka lord — the man born is without wealth.
A malefic in the lagna, without the lords of the 10th and the 9th, joined to or aspected by a maraka lord — the man born is without wealth.

Whichever bhava's lord stands in the 8th, 12th or 6th, and whichever bhava the lords of the 8th, 12th and 6th stand in — if aspected by malefics, or by Saturn, [the native] is overcome with sorrow, unsteady, and without wealth.
The lord of the navamsa the Moon occupies, joined to a maraka lord or gone to a maraka place — that man born is without wealth.
The lord of the navamsa of the lagna lord gone to the 12th, 6th or 8th, joined to or aspected by a maraka lord — that man born is without wealth.
Mars and the Moon standing in the 2nd are declared destroyers of wealth; aspected by Mercury they make great wealth. Saturn going there —
The Sun there, always aspected by Saturn, produces destitution; unaspected by Saturn the same Sun makes one renowned and possessed of great wealth.
Benefics gone to the 2nd bhava do indeed make much wealth; but Jupiter there, aspected by Mercury, makes the man destitute.
Mercury there, aspected by the Moon, certainly destroys everything one has; and by conjunctions with malefic grahas and the rest, poverty comes to men.

Whatever grahas are neither joined to nor aspected by the lord of the 9th and the lord of the 5th are givers of much sorrow; those joined in the 8th to the lord of the 12th, with a maraka lord, are givers of loss.

When malefics have gone to the auspicious places and benefics to the malefic places, want of wealth arises; the child is distressed for food, obtains food only now and then, and is full of anxiety to deceive.
Counted from the karaka or from the lagna, [malefics] in the 8th and the 12th, with the glance of the lagna and the karaka — the man is joined to the affliction of poverty.
Whoever has [a graha] in the 12th from the lagna or from the karaka, with the glance of the lagna and the karaka — the man becomes a spendthrift.
The lagna lord glancing the lagna and the karaka's lord glancing the karaka — even so, by preponderance, he is born a spender.
confinement, restraint, and bodily affliction
Jupiter's excellent dasa produces authority over broad villages, sons, prosperity, good fortune, a mine of virtues, dependants, and the splendour of a palanquin.
Ketu's excellent dasa produces victory, the gaining of wealth through fierce action, [favour of] a foreign ruler, fortune obtained, the beginning of undertakings, and the destruction of enemies.
Mars's excellent dasa produces the gaining of land, the coming of wealth, wisdom, clarity, boldness of mind, and younger brothers.
Mercury's excellent dasa produces clothing, endless grain and increase, welfare, comfort, a house, victory over one's own connexions, and the coming of desired objects.
The Moon's excellent dasa produces good for the mother, tanks and the like, fields, gardens, fine seats, the favour of the best of the twice-born, and a splendid palanquin.
Rahu's excellent dasa produces every kind of welfare, great royal fortune, enterprise, journeys to holy places, and the increase of knowledge and influence.
Saturn's excellent dasa produces splendour, discernment, sacrifices and such rites, fields and villages, leadership, much trade, and men skilful and eager.
The Sun's excellent dasa produces sons, understanding, wisdom, elevation of authority, knowledge and the coming of wealth, manliness, the attainment of comfort, and the favour of the lord.

Venus's excellent dasa gives comfort, the increase of good fortune, a palanquin, the eightfold lordship, the gaining of vehicles, garments and ornaments, the gain of elephants, horses and cattle, and friends.
Jupiter's evil dasa gives great fear, disease, the fall of firmness, ruin of grain, affliction to sons and to the father, hunger and wasting.
Ketu's evil dasa gives extreme hardship, fruitless and harmful undertakings, pain at the heart, fever in the bones, trembling, the hatred of the twice-born, and exceedingly foolish action.
Mars when evil gives severe illness, quarrel, thieves, bondage, wounds, agitation and injury.
Mercury's evil dasa gives going to a foreign country, agitation, the loss of one's own connexions, a mind bereft of wisdom, want of wealth, quarrel, and the ruin of land and property.
The Moon's evil dasa gives destruction of wealth, disease, loss of understanding, emaciation, distress and fevers.
Rahu's evil dasa gives fear of snakes, fear of poison, pain through all the limbs, blows, opposition, a fall, and the rise of affliction from enemies.
Saturn when evil gives the administering of poison, loss of wealth, the rise of pain, the king's anger, work turned against one, unsteady effort, and affliction of the limbs.
The Sun's evil dasa produces fruitless effort, loss of wealth, disease, royal disturbance, the anger of the king, and danger to the father.

In exaltation or own sign, in a kendra, the 11th, a trikona, moolatrikona, in an exalted or own navamsa: gain of kingdom, great comfort, royal honour and renown, elephants and horses, worship of gods and brahmins, happiness of wife and children, vehicles and garments, success in sacrificial rites, and the hearing of Vedanta.
Not recovered: the Ketu section of this chapter (djvu lines 15352-15360) gives only the utkrsta/papa pair and no placement-conditioned expansion.

In deep exaltation, exaltation, moolatrikona, own sign, a kendra, trikona, the 11th or the 2nd, with full strength, aspected by benefics and in a benefic amsa: gain of kingdom, gain of land, gain of wealth and grain, royal honour, vehicles, garments and ornaments, the gain of a place in a foreign country, and the happiness of brothers. In a kendra or the 3rd and strong: gain of wealth through valour and victory in battle.

In exaltation, own sign, a kendra, the 11th, a trikona or a friend's sign: great comfort, gain of wealth and grain, good fame and wealth, increase of knowledge, love of form, good works, increase of virtue, happiness of wife and children, bodily health, food with milk, and gain of wealth through trade. When aspected by benefics and lord of the 9th or 10th, the dasa is strong and gives its full result.

In exaltation or own sign, in a kendra, the 11th or a trikona, joined to a benefic and waxing and strong: gain of wealth and grain, auspicious acts in the house, a vehicle, the sight of the king, success in effort, the sidelong glance of Laksmi, fortune through friends, the gain of a kingdom, white garments, satisfaction in the gain of sons, and cattle in the house.

Rahu's exaltation is Taurus (Ketu's Scorpio), its moolatrikona Cancer, its own signs Gemini and Sagittarius, Virgo and Pisces being also called its houses: in its dasa then, much comfort, wealth and grain, what is desired through the favour of friends, vehicles, the birth of a son, the building of a new house, thoughts of dharma, great festivity, honour from a foreign king, garments and ornaments.

In exaltation, own sign, a friend's sign, moolatrikona, the 9th, an exalted or own navamsa, the 3rd or the 11th: royal honour and splendour, good fame and gain of wealth, learning and disputation, elephants, vehicles and ornaments by the king's favour, it works a raja-yoga, great comfort as a commander, the marks of Laksmi's glance, gain of kingdom, and in the house auspicious wealth with wife and children.

In own moolatrikona, own sign, exaltation or deep exaltation, in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, and strong in the vargas: great comfort, gain of wealth, exceeding royal honour, horses and palanquins. Joined to the lord of the 5th it gives the gain of a son; related to the lord of the 2nd, prosperity of the household; related to the lord of the 4th, the gain of three vehicles.

In a trikona in Pisces: kingdom, wealth and household prosperity; marriage festivities, the welfare and splendour of children, it confers command of an army and the meeting of desired kinsmen; the regaining of a lost kingdom, and the gathering of cattle in the house. When Venus is lord of the 9th or 10th and stands in the lagna or the 4th, that dasa gives great comfort, lordship of a district or village, and abundance in works of merit such as temples and tanks.

Debilitated, combust, joined to malefics, or in the 12th or 8th: fall from position, distress of mind, affliction to children, great fear, loss of cattle and wealth — though pilgrimage is obtained. The result is hard at the beginning; in the middle and at the end comfort, royal honour and splendour are attained.
Not recovered from this chapter.
Debilitated or in an evil house, destitute of strength, joined to malefics and aspected by malefics — that dasa is a giver of what is not desired.

Joined to or aspected by malefics: the king's hostility, sickness of mind, quarrel with kinsmen, going abroad, service under others, strangury and great fear. In the 6th, 8th or 12th: ruin of gain, enjoyment and wealth, windy affliction, jaundice, fear of the king's officers, and ruin of crops, cattle and land.

In the 6th, 8th or 12th, weak and joined to malefics: the king's hostility, sorrow of mind, destruction of wealth and grain, emaciation of the mother, distress of mind, and illness. Weak in the 2nd or debilitated, loss of wealth follows.

Joined to a malefic and to a maraka lord, or in a sign of debilitation: fall from position, sickness of mind, ruin of wife and sons, contemptible food, bodily affliction at the beginning of the dasa, and loss of wealth and grain; in the middle of the dasa comfort and gain of wealth through one's own wife; at the end hardship, fall from position and distress of mind.

In the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated or combust: affliction from poison and weapons, fall from position, great fear, separation from father and mother, affliction to wife and children, work contrary to the king, what is not desired, and imprisonment.

Debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, weak, joined to malefics, joined to Rahu or Ketu, or joined to the lord of an evil house: great affliction, destruction of wealth and grain, the king's anger, exile, royal punishment, loss of wealth, fever, loss of fame, quarrel with kinsmen and friends, wandering, disease, hostility, fear of death, fear of thieves and of wounds, fear of the father's loss, and inauspiciousness in the house.

In the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, or in the sign of the 12th: hatred of one's own kinsmen, affliction to the wife's people, loss of the fruit of business, loss of cows and buffaloes, affliction to wife and children, and separation from one's own kinsmen.

expected.result_summary: The lord of a bhava, possessed of strength and gone to its own house, or to exaltation, a trine or a benefic varga, surely produces the creature's result in full; when it stands in an enemy's or a debilitation place, and especially when it is weak, it produces the inauspicious result.
The dasa of the lord of the 5th, and that of the lord of the 9th, are declared exceedingly auspicious by the sages who know time.

The dasa of the lord of the 9th together with the lord of the 5th is auspicious and gives kingdom and sons; and so, say the generous-minded, is the dasa of the lord of the 4th together with the lord of the 10th.
The dasa of a graha joined to the lord of the 5th gives good; the dasa of a lord joined to the lord of the 9th is supremely splendid.
The dasa of a graha aspected by a malefic gives a kingdom; the dasa of a graha joined to a benefic gives wealth; and with the lord of the 5th in the lagna, the dasa gives a kingdom.
The dasa of the lord of the 9th together with the lord of the 5th gives kingdom, comfort and gain of wealth; and likewise the dasa of the lord of the 5th joined to the lord of the 10th is auspicious.

The dasa of the lord of the 10th joined to the lord of the 5th is auspicious; so is the dasa of the lord of the 9th together with the lord of the 4th; and so is the dasa of the lord of the 10th standing in the 5th.
When one graha is lord of both the 6th and the 7th and stands in the 10th, its dasa is to be known as auspicious, and so is that of a graha joined to it.
If one graha is lord of both the 2nd and the 7th and goes to the 4th, the dasa joined with it is to be known as auspicious, say the wise.
The lords of the 6th, the 8th and the 12th, joined to the lord of the 5th — their dasa too is declared a giver of good by the best of poets.
The lord of the 4th standing in the 10th and the lord of the 10th gone to the 4th — the dasa of both is auspicious, say those who know the science of light.
If the lords of the 5th, the 10th, the 4th and the 9th are joined together anywhere at all, their dasa gives the fruit of a kingdom — and so, one may say, does that of the grahas joined with them.

The dasa of the lord of the 5th joined to the 4th is auspicious; the dasa of the lord of the 10th standing in the 4th gives a kingdom; and the dasa of a graha joined to those two, or aspected by them, gives a kingdom, say the learned who reflect on fate.
The dasa of the lord of the 5th from the 10th makes prosperity; the dasa of the lord of the 9th standing in the 10th gives a kingdom.
In whichever bhava there is a relation of a benefic lord and an exalted graha, in the dasa of that bhava there is exceeding and unbroken lordship.
Whichever bhava's lord occupies or glances its own wealth-sign, at the time of that bhava's dasa there is very great gain of wealth.
Whatever stands in the 12th from a bhava brings destruction of wealth in its dasa; malefics in the trines from it bring the ruin of the self and of peace.

When the lords of the 12th and 8th, or the Sun, the Moon and Saturn, are in the trines from a bhava, there is loss of children, affliction to the father and great distress of mind; where Ketu and Rahu meet there, affliction to children and loss of property, wandering abroad, trouble and fear at every step.
Where malefic and debilitated grahas stand in the 6th and 8th from a bhava, there is repeated and scarcely bearable affliction, from disease or from the king.

Where a malefic is in the 4th from a bhava, house and field are destroyed; if Mars, loss of cattle and the burning of the house; if Saturn, pain at the heart; if the Sun, the king's wrath; if Rahu, the carrying off of all one has, and fear from poison and thieves.
Where Rahu is in the 10th from a bhava, there is pilgrimage to holy places.
Learning, wealth, righteousness, good works, fame and success in manly effort follow where exalted benefic grahas are in the 5th, the 7th and the 6th from a bhava.
In whichever place the lords of the 10th, the 9th and the lagna stand, the object of those bhavas is accomplished, and welfare follows according to the yoga.
For a graha in the amsa of debilitation or of an enemy: 'the Lowest' — increaser of fear, trouble, disease and sorrow.
For a graha come to a friend's sign or to exaltation by degrees: 'the Middle' — giver of wealth.
For a graha merely exalted, or of superior strength: 'the Full' — giver of much lordship, though it also gives sickness.
For a graha in deep debilitation and weak: 'the Empty' — giver of no fruit, and of disease and a hundred misfortunes.
For a graha in the middle band between the end of debilitation and the degree of exaltation: 'the Ascending'.
For a graha in deep exaltation and of surpassing strength: 'the Complete' — giver of kingdom, enjoyment and good, and of the sidelong glance of Laksmi.
Standing in the Parijata [varga-dignity], a king who instructs the world.
In the Uttama, a supreme king possessed of elephants, horses and chariots.
In the Gopura, a tiger in beauty, his feet worshipped by kings.
In the Simhasana, a universal emperor, protector of the whole earth.
ministerial office, royal honour, and the kendra-kona conjunction as the general maker of raja-yoga
raja-yoga framed either from the Jaimini karakas or from the lords of the 1st and 5th
When the lagna is in its own dvadasamsa, or its lord in its own drekkana, the sages who reflect on time call that bhukti auspicious.
If placed in its own trimsamsa, or in a friend's trimsamsa, that bhukti is declared auspicious by the wise who know time.
Standing in a friend's sign and navamsa, and in a friend's dvadasamsa, that bhukti is declared auspicious.
Standing in the sign and navamsa of the 5th, and in the dvadasamsa of the 5th, or in a friend's drekkana, that bhukti brings good.
Standing in the sign and navamsa of those, and in the dvadasamsa of the 9th, or in Jupiter's drekkana, that bhukti brings good.
Standing in the sign and navamsa of the 4th, and in the dvadasamsa of the 4th, or in the drekkana of the 4th, that bhukti is auspicious.
Multiply the [one] dasa by the [other] dasa and divide by ten; the quotient is months, and multiplied by thirty, days.
expected.worked_example_in_text: The text works it: the Sun's mahadasa being 6 years, the Sun's own antardasa within it is 6 x 6 = 36, divided by ten = 3 months and 18 days.
